question:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.

He wished he has more resources to support the poor.

options.text: He wished his having more resources to support the poor.
He wished he have more resources to support the poor.
He wishing he has more resources to support the poor.
He wished he had more resources to support the poor.

solution:
The solution is **He wished he had more resources to support the poor. **
